ev.q: 35% of cases were reported to MDHHS on the day of hospital admission
56% were reported within 1 day, and 79% were reported within 2 days
Inpatient data were more sensitive and had higher PPV than outpatient data.
Evaluation of surveillance efforts should be repeated periodically
examined by calculating sensitivity and positive predictive value

methods_quotes.q: examined by calculating sensitivity and positive predictive value
The completeness of meningococcal disease reporting was estimated by the Sekar-Deming capture-recapture method
Cases that could not have been reported to both MDHHS and MHDO were excluded from the capture-recapture analysis
Timeliness of reporting was assessed by determining the difference in days between hospital admission and notification to MDHHS.
Completeness of reporting was calculated as R / N
